entries.prompt: Revise this fresh NIL design into a much more distinctive, richly resolved production design for ZERO-SUM OMEN, while preserving face, right-wrist decoder, white hair with ONE orange streak, amber eyes, androgynous adult19, pose and basic silhouette.
